newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nepal mulls cancelling Oct kerosene tender.
newsitem.headline: Nepal mulls cancelling Oct kerosene tender.

text.p: State-owned Nepal Oil Corp (NOC) is considering whether or not to cancel its tender to buy superior kerosene for October 1-15 delivery, an NOC source said on Friday.
"We are still talking about the matter and a decision will be made in one hour," the source said. "If the tender is cancelled, we will issue another tender next week."
The tender seeks 30,000 tonnes of kerosene for delivery to the Indian east coast, on a cost-and-freight basis.
The tender, which closed on September 24, attracted seven to eight offers, with Kuwaiti-based International Petroleum Group (IPG) making the best offer of $245 per tonne.
The source said one reason for considering to cancel the tender was the small number of offers, but traders said the price level was deemed unattractive by NOC.
